candidate_replacement.hidden_definitions_description: Before compilation the evaluator renames these fixed definitions, which implement the target's behavior, in every source file, so a submission cannot reuse them by name.

test_programs.policy: Run every program in the fixed required-test catalog that matches the selection patterns. The fixed integration patch also checks integer CSR writeback across commit backpressure and abort using an independently driven scoreboard in the same core configuration.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches. The probe must complete in rv64ui-p-add and report no observation mismatch in any program.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Keep a completed integer CSR writeback stable across commit backpressure, and invalidate a completed but uncommitted writeback after abort.
